preconditions.name: oracle_resource_channel_clears_floor
preconditions.description: A greedy nearest-resource ORACLE (no agent) clears COMPETENCE_RESOURCE_FLOOR resources/episode in this exact env, proving the floor is ACHIEVABLE by a resource-seeking policy. Same statistic as the agent DV (env.step info transition_type=='resource'). Below-floor => the floor is not achievable here (env too sparse/lethal) => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a diffuse-deficit verdict.
preconditions.control: greedy nearest-resource oracle forager, same ENV_KWARGS/seed, no agent

preconditions.name: baseline_reproduces_incompetence
preconditions.description: The baseline arm A0 (719a all-ON config) must forage BELOW the floor on a majority of seeds -- i.e. the 719a incompetence must reproduce -- for a localization to be meaningful. If A0 already clears the floor the premise is not reproduced => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a localization.
preconditions.control: A0 baseline mean_resources/ep vs floor (majority of seeds)

preconditions.name: sufficient_p2_episodes_all_cells
preconditions.description: Every completed cell must log >= MIN_P2_EPISODES P2 eval episodes so mean_resources_per_episode is estimable. Below => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: min completed P2 episodes across all cells
